name: Catchuparr
description: Local rolling catch-up archive, start-over and optional live connection sharing for Dispatcharr
author: nilleiz

fields.label: Channel and source filter (YAML)
fields.help_text: Use version: 1 with channel rules selected by numbers, names, groups, or enabled profiles. Named-profile rules provide inherited source filters and schedules; direct channel rules can override them regardless of order. Omitted source filters inherit, explicit include/exclude replaces the filter, and explicit priority replaces the whole map. A rule schedule replaces the whole week by default; schedule_mode: override_days changes only specified expanded days. Day precedence is explicit weekday, group, then daily. Timezone is YAML timezone, valid container TZ, then detected system zone. Validate and Apply the complete settings together; blank YAML selects no channels. Filtered sources may need another provider slot.

fields.label: Share existing live connections
fields.help_text: When enabled, Catchuparr may reuse a compatible existing viewer connection for every selected channel. It never opens an excluded source.

fields.label: Try to synchronize before switching streams
fields.help_text: Try to match encoded audio and video before switching to a viewer. On return, first finish viewer cleanup, then try to match the new source to the archive tail. Without a safe overlap after about 12 seconds, use the normal switch. This does not guarantee a gapless recording. Apply this setting before use.

fields.label: Live stability delay (seconds)
fields.help_text: Delay before switching to a newly eligible live connection. The first attach to an already eligible viewer is immediate. Enter an integer from 0 to 3600.

fields.label: Return delay after last viewer leaves (seconds)
fields.help_text: Wait after the last ordinary viewer leaves before returning to an allowed source. Enter an integer from 0 to 3600.

fields.label: Minimum interval between switches (seconds)
fields.help_text: Minimum time between later source switches. The first attach has no switch cooldown. Enter an integer from 0 to 3600.

fields.label: Confirm global sharing settings migration
fields.help_text: If previous per-channel settings differ, choose the global values above and enable this box to confirm them. Until confirmed, Validate and Apply leave the current configuration unchanged.

fields.label: Archive path
fields.help_text: A local filesystem shared by web and Celery workers.

fields.label: User ID for new M3U token
fields.help_text: Set the Dispatcharr user ID before creating an access token.

fields.label: Public base URL for token links
fields.help_text: Optional absolute http(s) URL reachable by playback clients. It may include a path prefix, but no credentials, query, or fragment. Apply this with the rest of the settings before creating a token; token creation requires it.

fields.label: Recording enabled
fields.help_text: Apply configuration validates and activates this setting with the rest of the configuration. Pause and Resume remain immediate recording controls.

fields.label: Catchuparr log level
fields.help_text: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR. Applies to Catchuparr logs only.

fields.label: Show archive playback in Stats
fields.help_text: Adds active Catchuparr archive viewers to native Timeshift Stats.

fields.label: Hide recorders in Stats
fields.help_text: Hides only positively identified Catchuparr recorder clients from live details.

fields.label: Add Catchuparr catch-up to native output
fields.help_text: Adds local archive catch-up metadata to eligible channels in Dispatcharr M3U and XMLTV output. Disabled by default. Apply this setting with the rest of the configuration.

actions.label: Current recordings
actions.description: What each selected channel records right now.

actions.label: Today's channel schedule
actions.description: Today's recording windows from the channel schedules.

actions.label: Today's shows schedule
actions.description: Today's programmes planned by the show rules.

actions.label: Archive status
actions.description: Archive size, retention and running recorders.

actions.label: Validate configuration
actions.description: Checks the settings above without changing anything.

confirm.title: Apply the configuration?
confirm.message: Catchuparr activates the settings above. Every running recorder restarts, which leaves a short gap in each running recording.

actions.label: Reconcile recorders
actions.description: Re-reads the EPG and starts or stops recorders to match the schedule.

confirm.title: Reconcile the recorders?
confirm.message: Catchuparr re-reads the EPG, plans the show windows again, starts recorders that should run and stops recorders that should not.

actions.label: Reattach to preferred sources
actions.description: Moves recorders on a fallback source back to their preferred source.

confirm.title: Reattach to the preferred sources?
confirm.message: Recorders on a fallback source switch back to their preferred source. Each switch leaves a gap of a few seconds in that channel's archive.

confirm.title: Pause recording?
confirm.message: All recorders stop immediately and nothing is recorded until you resume. Playback of the existing archive keeps working.

confirm.title: Resume recording?
confirm.message: Recorders start again for every channel that is scheduled now.

actions.label: Create M3U/XMLTV access token
actions.description: Creates playlist and guide links for the user ID above.
